title: Magical Explorer Anime Casts Saori Ōnishi
content:
The official website for the television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series revealed a new cast member and a new visual on Friday. Saori Ōnishi will play Yukine Mizumori.

The character is pictured at right in the below new teaser visual.

Kazuki Ohashi ( Shadows House ) is directing the anime at WHITE FOX . Satoko Sekine ( TsukiPro the Animation ) is handling series composition. Ryosuke Kimiya ( Grimoire of Zero ) is designing the characters. Kenichiro Suehiro ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- ) is composing the music.

Yen Press is publishing the light novel series and Yukari Higa 's manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

Living in the world of Magical★Explorer, the legendary erotic game, sounds like a dream. Problem is, I reincarnated not as the lady-killer protagonist with his overpowered cheat skills, but as his unlucky comic-relief best friend!

The novel series debuted in February 2018 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website. Kadokawa began publishing the light novel series in November 2019. The 13th volume shipped on April 1.

The manga adaptation launched in Young Ace Up in August 2020. Kadokawa published the manga's third compiled book volume on January 8.
author: ANN

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects Anime Reveals Theme Songs, July 10 Debut in Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of Fuurou 's The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects ( Ryōmin 0-nin Start no Henkyō Ryōshu-sama ) light novel series revealed a second promotional video on Friday, along with the show's July 10 debut, more cast, and the opening and ending theme song artists.

Japanese-Korean pop-rock band Crown Head performs the opening theme song "Wonder," and Kaya performs the ending theme song "Hoshi Furu Yoru no Yakusoku" (The Promise of the Night of Falling Stars). The above video previews the opening theme.

The new cast includes (character name romanizations are not confirmed):

• Rikuya Yasuda as Francis

• Maria Abo as Francois

• Kujira as Mole

• Yōko Hikasa as Diane

• Nao Tōyama as Eima

The anime will debut on July 10 at 10:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX . The series will then air on MBS on July 11, BS Asahi on July 12, and AT-X on July 14.

The anime stars:

• Kenichirō Matsuda as Dias

• Shion Wakayama as Alna

• Taito Ban as Klaus

• Miku Itō as Senai

• Haruka Shiraishi as Aihan

• Jun Fukuyama as Eldan

Kenichi Imaizumi ( Kingdom season 3-6) is directing the anime at animation studio42 , and Kunihiko Okada ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman , Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra ) is overseeing the series scripts. Keiichi Tsuboyama ( Fireworks, Should We See it from the Side or the Bottom? animation director) is designing the characters.

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series and its manga adaptation in English, and it describes the "slow-life fantasy" story:

Dias finally returns home after decades of war. He's hailed as a hero and promptly rewarded with his own domain...which turns out to be little more than empty plains. Population: zero. Dias, who has only ever known battle, finds himself at a loss. How is he supposed to survive, let alone cultivate his territory into a thriving, prosperous dominion when there's nothing but grass as far as can see? Fortunately for Dias, a horned girl by the name of Alna is about to show him there's more to the plains than meets the eye!

Fuurou began serializing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō service on January 20, 2018. The Earth Star Novel imprint publishes the novel series with illustrations by Kinta , and Yumbo (who is credited in the anime's staff listing) is drawing the manga adaptation with 14 volumes so far. The franchise has over two million copies in circulation so far.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Uchuujin MuuMuu' Concludes Seven-Year Serialization
content:
Hiroki Miyashita 's Uchuujin MuuMuu ( Me and the Alien Mumu ) manga has concluded in the July 2026 issue of Young King OURs on May 29, marking the end of its nearly 7-year-long serialization.

Miyashita began serializing the comedy sci-fi manga in Young King OURs magazine in June 2019. Shonen Gahosha published the ninth volume in September 2025, with the tenth and final volume planned for a July 30 release.

Produced by OLM , the first season aired in Spring 2025 and consisted of 24 episodes. It was simulcast on Animation Digital Network and Bahamut Anime Crazy in Germany, France, and Taiwan with English subtitles.

Kodama Tales licensed the manga in English in September 2025 and released the second volume on April 1. The third volume is scheduled to release on June 1.

Synopsis A cat-like alien from a distant galaxy, MuuMuu, arrives on Earth. His goal is to learn about home appliance technology on Earth to recover the technology his species has lost. The protagonist, Sakurako, has a typical university life, but everything changes with MuuMuu's arrival! What begins as an unexpected cohabitation quickly turns into a whirlwind of chaotic events. The chemistry between Sakurako and MuuMuu leads to a super-spectacular, appliance-filled, and cat comedy adventure. (Source: Pony Canyon)
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Fuurou 's Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama ( The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects: The Blue-Horned Maiden ) revealed additional cast, staff, the theme songs, and second promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 10 at 10:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by MBS, BS Asahi and AT-X.

Cast Francis: Rikuya Yasuda ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) Francois: Maria Abo ( Mono ) Maure: Kujira ( Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ) Diane: Youko Hikasa ( High School DxD ) Eima: Nao Touyama ( Yuru Camp△ )

Staff Color Design: Hiroyasu Kanemitsu ( Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou ) Art Director: Kusanagi Director of Photography: Kouji Tanaka ( Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou ) Editing: Masato Yoshitake ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) Sound Director: Masaki Tsuchiya ( Wotaku ni Koi wa Muzukashii ) Sound Production: INSPION Edge Music: Sakiko Sakuragi

Japanese pop-rock band CROWN HEAD ( Kun Tun Tianxia Zhi Zhang Men Guilai ) is performing the opening theme "Wonder." Singer Kaya ( Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru ) is performing the ending theme "Hoshi Furu Yoru no Yakusoku." The opening theme is previewed in the second promo below.

Kenichi Imaizumi ( Kingdom 3rd Season ) is directing the anime at animation studio42 , with Kunihiko Okada ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru ) handling the series composition. Keiichi Tsuboyama ( PriPri Chii-chan!! chief animation director) is designing the characters.

Fuurou began penning the fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2018. Earth Star Entertainment later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint with illustrations by Kinta in October 2018 and published the 14th volume in September 2025.

Yumbo began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth☆Star website in December 2018. Earth Star Entertainment published the 14th volume on January 9.

J-Novel Club licensed the light novel and manga adaptation for digital release in English in September 2023 and July 2023 , respectively. The 13th light novel volume went on sale on April 14, with the 14th volume planned for a June 22 release. The 13th manga volume was released on May 13.

PV 2

title: 'Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen' Reveals Supporting Cast, Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hiroshi Shiibashi 's Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen ( Recommendation from Mr. Iwamoto ) manga announced a supporting pair of cast and theme songs on Friday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 10.30 p.m. followed by Sun TV every Saturday beginning July 4.

Voice actors Gen Satou ( Übel Blatt ) and Shinnosuke Tokudome ( Saikyou no Ousama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru? ) are joining the cast as Ryuu Sazame and Mizuka Awatama, respectively.

Japanese boy-band THE JET BOY BANGERZ is performing the opening theme "BUDDING," and WOLF HOWL HARMONY is performing the ending theme "Koko ni Iru."

Toshifumi Kawase ( Raise wa Tanin ga Ii ) is helming the anime at Studio Deen . Keiichirou Oochi ( Mononogatari ) is handling the series composition. Atsuko Nakajima ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ) is designing the characters, while Yoshiaki Dewa ( Jigokuraku ) and Toru Ishitsuka ( Kuro no Su: Chronus ) are composing the music.

Shiibashi began the manga as a one-shot in Shounen Jump+ web magazine in March 2020 before it began regular serialization in Ultra Jump in February 2021. Shueisha published the 13th volume on January 19, with the 14th volume scheduled to release on July 17.

title: Agents of the Four Seasons Releases Climax Visual, Trailer
content:
Agents of the Four Seasons anime released the climax visual and trailer of the anime. Wit Studio is animating the series. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime which currently has nine episodes.

The cast consists of:

• Yuka Nukui as Hinagiku Kayo

• Yoshino Aoyama as Sakura Himedaka

• Sumire Uesaka as Ruri Hazakura

• Ranko Baba as Ayame Hazakura

• Hime Sawada as Nadeshiko Iwaizuki

• Taku Yashiro as Rindo Azami

• Shogo Sakata as Rosei Kantsubaki

• Satoshi Hino as Itecho Kangetsu

Ken Yamamoto is directing the series with Ayumu Hisao handling the script, Namiko Torii designing the characters, and Kensuke Ushio composing the music. Kana Akatsuki ( Violet Evergarden ) writes the light novel, and it began its publication under ASCII Media Works’ Dengeki Bunko light novel imprint in April 2021. Yen Press is licensing the light novel, describing it as follows: Winter was once the only season in the world-but such an existence was too lonely to bear, and so it created Spring to love. Before long, the earth wished for more time to rest in the cycle, and Summer and Autumn were born. The ones who carry the cycle are called the Agents of the Four Seasons. Hinagiku, the Agent of Spring, disappeared from this land ten years ago, taking the season of spring with her. Now, after incredible hardship, she has returned to restore the cycle to its proper state-and, as in the myth passed down since the dawn of time, she sends her love to Winter.

title: Additional Cast for 'Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shuu 's Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ( Victoria of Many Faces ) light novel announced additional cast on Friday. The anime will premiere on TV Tokyo networks in July 2026.

Cast Lancome: Kenji Nojima ( Champignon no Majo ) Edward Asher: Daisuke Ono ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) Yorana Haynes: Saeko Akiho ( Witch Watch ) Bernard Fitcher: Hiroshi Yanaka ( Kizoku Tensei ) Zaharo: Makoto Furukawa ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken ) Cedric Ashbery: Kensho Ono ( Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai ) Conrad Ashbery: Ryouta Oosaka ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru ) Clark Anderson: Megumi Han ( Clevatess )

Japanese band KI_EN is performing the ending theme "En no Tsuki."

Nobukage Kimura ( Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita ) is directing the anime at Studio Deen . Naohiro Fukushima ( Tensei Kenja no Isekai Life ) is handling the series composition. Mina Oosawa ( Maou no Ore ga Dorei Elf wo Yome ni Shitanda ga, Dou Medereba Ii? ) is designing the characters, while Moe Hyuuga ( Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken ) is composing the music.

Shuu began penning the fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website from September to November in 2021, launching a sequel in April 2022. Kadokawa began publishing the light novel through its MF Books imprint in July 2022, featuring illustrations by Nanna Fujimi . The third volume went on sale in January 2024, with the fourth volume scheduled to release on June 25.

Komo Ushino began drawing a manga adaptation on the ComicWalker platform in December 2022. Kadokawa released the sixth volume on February 16.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English in September 2024 and February 2025, respectively. The third novel volume was published in November 2025. The third manga volume was released on February 10, and the fourth volume is scheduled to go on sale on September 22.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Victoria of Many Faces Anime Reveals 8 More Cast Members
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed eight more cast members on Friday.

The new cast members include:

The anime stars:

• Chika Anzai as Victoria

• Shion Wakayama as Nonna

• Yōhei Azakami as Jeffrey

Nobukage Kimura ( Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 , episode director for tsuritama , Kakuriyo -Bed & Breakfast for Spirits- ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN . Naohiro Fukushima ( I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level 2 , #COMPASS2.0 ANIMATION PROJECT ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Mina Ōsawa ( Given franchise) is designing the characters for animation. Frontier Works is credited for the original work planning.

Three-piece band KI_EN performs the ending theme song "En no Tsuki"

Additional staff includes:

• Sub-Character Designers: Keika Ōtsuka, Sayuri Sakimoto, Yuri Naminoue, Mana Matsumura

• Prop Design: Yabomi

• Color Key Artist: Mizuki Nakagawa

• Art Director: Si Man Wei

• Compositing Director of Photography: Ren Zhou Li

• Editing: Megumi Uchida

• Sound Director: Satoshi Yano

• Sound Effects: Hidemi Tanaka

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

• Music: Moe Hyūga (The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten, Steins;Gate 0, If My Favorite Pop Idol Made it to the Budokan, I Would Die)

• Music Production: Kadokawa

• Animation Producers: Takayuki Saitō, Naoki Sakai

Yen Press is publishing the light novel series in English and it describes the story:

In an age when spies act behind the scenes in every land, Chloe spends her days successfully carrying out even the most difficult missions due to her unparalleled disguise skills and martial arts abilities. After the betrayal of her boss, she suddenly disappears—as Chloe plans to redo her life as the ordinary citizen Victoria in the neighboring kingdom of Ashberry, striving for a “normal” life. However, Victoria's peaceful life is abruptly cut short as she begins to get involved with many people. In this new land, her experiences and abilities from her days as a spy come in far more useful than she ever expected! On the other hand, the second prince--and others--take an interest in Victoria's strength, and the shadows close in on the woman with many faces…!

Syuu launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in December 2021 and the latest update was in February 2022. Kadokawa published the third novel volume in print in January 2024.

Komo Ushino is drawing a manga adaptation, which launched on Kadokawa 's Flos Comic website in December 2022. The manga's sixth compiled book volume shipped on February 16. Yen Press is also publishing the manga adaptation in English.
author: ANN

On the other hand, the second prince--and others--take an interest in Victoria's strength, and the shadows close in on the woman with many faces…!
Syuu launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in December 2021 and the latest update was in February 2022. Kadokawa published the third novel volume in print in January 2024.

Komo Ushino is drawing a manga adaptation, which launched on Kadokawa 's Flos Comic website in December 2022. The manga's sixth compiled book volume shipped on February 16. Yen Press is also publishing the manga adaptation in English.

title: NIPPON SANGOKU Reveals Episode 9 Preview
content:
NIPPON SANGOKU revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 9, which is set to premiere on Sunday, May 31. Studio Kafka is in charge of the animation. The anime is co-produced with Amazon MGM Studios and is currently streaming weekly on Prime Video.

Episode 9 is titled “The Frontier Generals Mobilize,” and you can see the preview images and synopsis below.

The decisive battle between Ohga Wajima and Mitsuhide Ryumon ended in a strategic victory for Ryumon through the use of the Empty Fort Strategy, and it had become clear to everyone that Wajima’s prestige had been shattered. Wajima placed his hopes in a plan devised by his trusted strategist, Yayakichi Hei, but…

The voice cast for the anime includes:

• Kensho Ono as Aoteru Misumi

• Seto Asami as Saki Higashimachi

• Takashi Nagasako as Denki Taira

• Megumi Han as Narrator

The staff includes:

• Original Story: “NIPPON SANGOKU” by Ikka Matsuki, published by Shogakukan

• Director: Kazuaki Terasawa

• Character Design/Chief Animation Director: Takahiko Abiru

• Animation Studio: STUDIO KAFKA (The Ancient Magus’ Bride)

• Production: NIPPON SANGOKU Partners

NIPPON SANGOKU (meaning “Japan: Three Kingdoms”) is a manga series by Ikka Matsuki, who serves as both writer and artist. The series started publication in November 2021 through Shogakukan’s Ura Sunday platform and the MangaONE app. The official introduction:

In a near-future Japan where civilization has regressed due to nuclear war, natural disasters, and corrupt governance. The nation fractures into three, plunging into a new Three Kingdoms era as each vies for supremacy. Aoteru Misumi, once an obscure local bureaucrat, sets his sights on the reunification of Japan. Armed with vast knowledge and exceptional eloquence, he steadily rises. The legend of the man later known as the prodigious strategist begins now.

title: Recommendation from Mr. Iwamoto Anime Reveals More Cast, Theme Song Artists, July 4 Debut
content:
The staff for the television anime of Hiroshi Shiibashi 's Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen ( Recommendation from Mr. Iwamoto ) manga revealed on Friday the theme song artists, additional cast members, and July 4 debut. THE JET BOY BANGERZ will perform the opening theme song "Budding," and WOLF HOWL HARMONY will perform the ending theme song "Koko ni Iru" (I Am Here).

The newly announced cast includes:

The anime will debut on Tokyo MX on July 4 at 10:30 p.m. and then on Sun TV at 11:00 p.m.

The anime stars:

• Taito Ban as Kodō Iwamoto

• Yuki Sakakihara as Kai Haramachi

• Kent Itō as Sōichirō Amaha

• Akira Ishida as Bōkyo Kizujō

• Masaya Fukunishi as Oni Okuaki

• Takuma Nagatsuka as Shizuma Aonuma

Toshifumi Kawase ( Tenjho Tenge , Shion no Oh , Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN . Keiichirō Ōchi ( The Quintessential Quintuplets , Girlfriend, Girlfriend ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Atsuko Nakajima ( Hakuoki: Demon of the Fleeting Blossom , Komi Can't Communicate ) is the character designer. Takuya Hiramitsu ( The Prince of Tennis , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's ) is the sound director, and Yoshiaki Dewa ( Hell's Paradise , Call of the Night ) and Tōru Ishitsuka ( Gekijōban Ansatsu Kyōshitsu Minna no Jikan , Fate/Grand Order: First Order ) are composing the music.

The manga takes place in the 1910s, and centers on Kodō Iwamoto, a third-year student at Seihō Middle School, which is directly controlled by the military and is dedicated to the collection and research of supernatural phenomena to harness that power for military use. Under orders from the military, Kodō travels around the country to investigate supernatural phenomena. In one town where it is rumored that "black snow" falls, he meets a boy who thinks his mysterious powers are an illness. Kodō shows the boy how to use his powers, and offers him a letter of recommendation to Seihō Middle School. As he travels to other areas, Kodō encounters many other mysterious events.

Shiibashi launched the manga in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine in February 2021, after publishing a one-shot pilot in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app in March 2020. Shueisha published the 13th compiled book volume on January 19.

Shiibashi's Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan ( Nurarihyon no Mago ) manga ran from 2008 to 2012 with 25 volumes and inspired two television anime seasons in 2010 and 2011. Viz Media published the manga in English. Shiibashi published four more chapters for the manga in 2023.

Shiibashi is the creator of the Illegal Rare , Tsukumogami: Teito Jōhōbu Tokkenchobōin Serosero Nanashiki , and Yui Kamio Lets Loose manga.
